relevance_note: A broad 2017 primary-immunodeficiency review whose only individual-level TNFAIP3 content is one previously published case: "an infant with lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly and persistent fever" in whom "Takagi et al.^37 found a biallelic mutation in the TNFAIP3 (HA20) gene"; all other HA20 content (Zhou et al. six families; cohort studies ^38,39; Table 5) is group-level and yields no rows.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no table was transcribed by script (a short Python script only assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and spans). One individual row, labelled 'an infant' (the paper's own wording), taken from the review's summary of Takagi et al.^37; source_reference_in_review gives the in-text citation and reference-list entry [37.]. Zhou et al. ('six unrelated families') and the cohort studies (^38,39) are group-level only, so no rows. No HGVS is printed: variant_original_string is the prose description; transcript/cDNA/protein/genomic left missing. Zygosity left 'not reported' because the text says 'biallelic', which does not distinguish homozygous from compound heterozygous; variant_type left 'not reported' because 'predicting a truncated protein' does not state nonsense vs frameshift vs splice. 'persistent fever' recorded as an observed feature but the checklist item 'recurrent fever' left 'not reported' (persistent is not recurrent). age_at_diagnosis recorded as 'infant' from 'By using WES in an infant'. disease_label_as_stated left 'not reported' (the review gives the infant no diagnosis; the reference-list title mentions autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome but that is the cited paper's title). Inconsistencies in the paper: (1) the text says 'a biallelic mutation' for this infant, whereas the reference [37.] title says 'Haploinsufficiency of TNFAIP3 (A20) by germline mutation' and Table 5 lists TNFAIP3 as 'Autosomal Dominant'; (2) reference numbering is inconsistent: text cites 'Zhou et al.^36' but reference [36.] is Guo et al. (EXTL3) and no Zhou reference is listed; Table 5 cites TNFAIP3 to ^37,38,39 and EXTL3 to ^34,35,36 while the text uses ^37 (Takagi), ^38,39 (cohorts) and ^33,34,35 (EXTL3). The Takagi attribution is consistent by author name ([37.] TakagiM).
